defects.summary: Several operations still run on the GUI thread and scale with project size: project open/recent/sample, report export, backup, save, the result commit plus full refresh, a deep copy of the whole project before Run comparison and Rank changes, and a full navigator rebuild on every search keystroke.
defects.evidence: src/patchtrace/ui.py:1886,1894,1949,1960,1964 (open/backup/sample/save via _guard), :3009 (export_report), :2767 and :2440 (project.model_copy(deep=True)), :1987-2041 (filter_matches rebuild, connected to search.textChanged), :2797-2800 (apply_import/apply_analysis + refresh in the result slot)
defects.failure_scenario: Synthetic measurement in this sandbox (shared 4 cores, FunctionRecord code+assembly 1.5 KB per side): 30,000 matches -> model_copy(deep=True) 1.31 s and filter_matches 0.23-0.30 s per keystroke on the GUI thread; 10,000 matches -> 0.39 s and 0.09-0.12 s. Export/backup/open of a large project were not measured (UNVERIFIED) but have no worker. The window does not repaint or accept Cancel during these calls.
defects.proposed_fix: Debounce the navigator search (single-shot QTimer); move export, backup and open to start_job/TaskRunner with the existing adopt-on-GUI-thread pattern; build the run snapshot inside the worker from an immutable handle or copy only what run_comparison reads.
defects.regression_test: New tests/test_ui_responsiveness.py: 30k synthetic matches, type 5 characters with QTest -> filter_matches called once after the debounce; export_report with a blocking fake service keeps window.worker set and the event loop spinning (a QTimer tick fires before completion).

defects.summary: Legacy code panes always tint changed rows with the DARK theme tokens and never re-highlight on a theme change, so in the System theme on a light palette (and in a light OS high-contrast theme, which is applied automatically) changed lines render dark-on-dark.
defects.evidence: src/patchtrace/ui.py:2131 and :2634 (DARK.hunk_replace / DARK.hunk_other); src/patchtrace/gui/qt/theme.py:250 (stylesheet cleared for non-dark); host.py:365-369 (theme_changed reaches panels only)
defects.failure_scenario: Offscreen repro on the synthetic sample (scratch script, PySide6 6.12.0): View > Theme > System on a light palette -> changed row background #263a43 with pane text #000000, contrast 1.77:1 (WCAG AA needs 4.5:1; dark theme measures 9.01:1). The changed code, the product's core output, is unreadable. Rendering on real Windows high-contrast themes is UNVERIFIED.
defects.proposed_fix: Use the host's current tokens (self.panels.tokens.hunk_replace/hunk_other, underline in high contrast) in _highlight_hunks and _render_raw, and re-run the highlight when ThemeController.theme_changed fires. Net ui.py growth must stay within the 12-line seam headroom (3065 of 3077).
defects.regression_test: tests/test_ui_m4_selections.py: set_variant('system') on a light palette, select the sample's modified match, assert every 'diff' extra selection background equals host.tokens.hunk_* and contrast_ratio(pane text, background) >= 4.5; switch back to dark and assert #263a43.

defects.summary: Function names and code from an analysis run or an imported Ghidriff JSON reach the match navigator and the legacy code panes without the untrusted-text sanitizer (bidirectional overrides and C0 controls pass through).
defects.evidence: src/patchtrace/ui.py:2014-2019 (QListWidgetItem text from f.name), :2077-2118 (setPlainText of raw code); src/patchtrace/normalization.py:37-104 (no character filtering); contrast: show_external_pair uses codediff.view_text (ui.py:2383-2391)
defects.failure_scenario: Offscreen repro: a FunctionRecord named 'check_\u202ehtua' with code containing U+202E and BEL -> navigator item text and older pane text both still contain U+202E and \x07. A crafted import (File > Import Ghidriff JSON) or symbol name can visually reorder a function name or a code line (Trojan-Source style) in a tool whose purpose is security review. No code execution.
defects.proposed_fix: Sanitize at display: gui.text.sanitize_text for navigator labels; replace hostile non-line-break characters per line (hostile_text.escape_text) before alignment so row counts and evidence line numbers are unchanged. Provenance copy keeps the stored text.
defects.regression_test: tests/test_ui_audit_p2.py (or new tests/test_ui_untrusted_text.py): inject a match whose name and code carry U+202E, U+2066 and \x07; assert neither navigator.item().text() nor views[side].toPlainText() contains a Cf/Cc character other than newline, and that the hunk row index still points at the changed line.

defects.summary: ui.Worker.run catches Exception only. A task that raises SystemExit leaves the QThread running forever under PySide6 6.12, so the window stays busy, Cancel does nothing and closing the window is refused.
defects.evidence: src/patchtrace/ui.py:222-226 (except Exception), :3049-3054 (closeEvent ignores the close while self.worker is set)
defects.failure_scenario: Repro (bare QThread, PySide6 6.12.0 offscreen): run() raising SystemExit -> no finished signal, isRunning() True after 3 s; in MainWindow the job label keeps counting and worker never clears. No production code path that raises SystemExit inside a worker task was found (grep: only __main__ style entry points), so this is defence in depth.
defects.proposed_fix: Catch BaseException in Worker.run and emit failed(type name), as gui/qt/tasks.py:_execute already does.
defects.regression_test: New test in tests/test_ui_backend_progress.py: start_job with a task raising SystemExit(3); wait until window.worker is None; assert show_error was called once and the job label starts with 'Error'.

defects.summary: A Lane whose init raises a BaseException (not an Exception) dies silently: every queued request stays in TaskRunner._running and busy() is true for ever.
defects.evidence: src/patchtrace/gui/qt/tasks.py:426-429 (_lane_loop: except Exception around init()); audit GUI-13 fixed only the task path (docs/audits/20261015-fixes-gui-ops.md)
defects.failure_scenario: A lane init that raises KeyboardInterrupt or SystemExit ends the lane thread before the request loop; later lane.submit calls never deliver a result or an error. Static finding.
defects.proposed_fix: Catch BaseException around init and keep serving requests with the failure, as the Exception path does.
defects.regression_test: tests/test_gui_tasks.py: lane with init raising SystemExit; submit one request; assert on_error receives TaskFailure('SystemExit') and runner.busy() becomes False.

defects.summary: MainWindowPort.copy_text refuses text over 16 KiB by returning False, and most callers ignore the result, so Copy can do nothing without any message. One caller truncates by characters, not bytes.
defects.evidence: src/patchtrace/gui/qt/host.py:185-189; callers that ignore the result: src/patchtrace/callgraph/panel_qt.py:704 ([:16 * 1024] characters), src/patchtrace/ui_leads.py:681, src/patchtrace/intelligence/tools/capa_qt.py:529, src/patchtrace/buildenv/qt_panel.py:133, src/patchtrace/search/qt_panel.py:423
defects.failure_scenario: The Calls detail pane holds 16,384 characters including one non-ASCII character (a function name): the slice is 16,384 characters but more than 16,384 bytes, copy_text returns False and the clipboard keeps its old content while the user believes the detail was copied. Static finding.
defects.proposed_fix: Have copy_text report the refusal through status and announce ('Too large to copy: limit 16 KiB'), and truncate the Calls detail on a UTF-8 byte boundary.
defects.regression_test: tests/test_gui_host.py: copy_text of 16 KiB + 1 returns False and the recording announcer holds one message; tests/test_ui_graph_panel.py: a detail of 16,384 'é' copies at most 16,384 bytes.
